panels.name: Create DB Cluster
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* "\"eventSource\":\"rds.amazonaws.com\"" ("\"engine\":\"aurora-postgresql\"") CreateDBCluster
| json "userIdentity", "eventSource", "eventName", "awsRegion", "sourceIPAddress", "userAgent", "eventType", "recipientAccountId", "requestParameters", "responseElements", "errorCode", "errorMessage" nodrop
| json field=userIdentity "type", "principalId", "arn", "userName" nodrop
